front.title: Problem Statement: YANG Modeling for Protocol Buffer Based Network APIs

abstract.t:
Network devices increasingly expose operational APIs using gRPC and Protocol Buffers. Many of these APIs provide ephemeral or runtime state whose lifetime is limited to a process, service, session, or device runtime. At the same time, the IETF has standardized YANG as a data modeling language for network management and has defined encodings for YANG data, including JSON and CBOR. This document describes the problem space and identifies questions for the IETF community regarding standards-based gRPC APIs for ephemeral operational state.
The scope is limited to ephemeral operational state. Configuration data and configuration management operations are out of scope.
